name: ju88
_comment: FlightGear model coords (x aft, y right, z up, metres) of Ju-88/Models/ju88a4.ac, which is the input (not Ju-88-A4.xml): the XML animations use the .ac frame, while its top-level <offsets> (x -7.1) would move only the main .ac. Its only sub-models are prop discs from the beaufighter package (not used). The .ac has the gear modelled down and the gear doors closed (door animations are 0 deg at position-norm 0), so the struts and wheels are dropped; the tail wheel is turned up by its retraction rotation.
